item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00392","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C04","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 plausibly supplied a concrete loan-eligibility formula used in the child: government loans conditioned on financing being unavailable on reasonable terms from private or other governmental sources. The child adapts that distinctive administrative machinery to emergency urban-transit projects and adds a project-consistency finding. C04 contains the same formula but is an earlier, broader source provision; C01 is the closer and more compact antecedent. C03 shares the legislative-transmittal setting and the proposed Department of Urban Affairs and Housing, but those parallels are less distinctive and materially weaker.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"emergency loans may be essential for projects found by the Administrator to be consistent with the probable comprehensive transit plan for the area, if financing is not available on reasonable terms from private sources or elsewhere in the Federal Government","parent_excerpt":"Loans... shall be made only after the Secretary has determined in each instance that financial assistance is not available on reasonable terms from private sources or from other governmental sources","explanation":"The child closely adapts C01's distinctive two-source unavailability condition as the prerequisite for federal lending."},{"child_excerpt":"a temporary one-year authority for emergency loans","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Treasury... is hereby authorized and directed to make loans (including participations in, or guarantees of, loans)","explanation":"Both use federally administered lending authority, with the child adapting the mechanism to urgent urban transportation needs."}]}
